answer: Each participant registers as a topological vertex in a bounded liquidity network. Every vertex must lock a 50 POA non-refundable bond and anchor throughput to an audited physical copper delay module. Protocol influence follows bottleneck min-cut capacity: like a diverted river, splitting volume across ten accounts yields ten small trickles that share one narrow channel, never multiplying rewards.
